defaults.bio:
I'm {{profile.name}}, a Security Engineer at {{profile.company}} and a Full-Stack Developer with 3+ years of development experience. My security work focuses on penetration testing, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Identity & Access Governance (IAG), and web application and API security.

Alongside my security role, I work as a freelance web developer and have completed 10+ freelance projects, including point-of-sale (POS) software, custom business systems, websites, and web applications. I also support website search engine optimization (SEO).

My development background helps me understand systems from implementation through to security testing. I build tools in Go and Python, automate repetitive tasks, and work with engineering teams on practical fixes. AI-assisted workflows support my research; findings stay human-validated.
